event.summary: Real host tests and shared close preserve the removed teardown guarantees
event.detail: Reviewed commit: 1ed482dde220452e424973faf38a5e1318986333. SPEC.md:2164-2168 requires automatic silent tab removal; SPEC_impl.md:2333-2346 requires the deadness recheck followed by the same end-and-sweep close. Suggested bucket: other (test coverage concern only). Confidence: confirmed source analysis, no runtime execution. proposed_drop: the removed tmux fixture exercised an unsupported substrate; real host exit cleanup and tab-specific daemon/sibling protection retain source-level regression coverage through the shared close. Confidence: confirmed source distinction; no execution. proposed_drop: no independent assigned-scope production defect established; complementary coverage supports only the stated pieces, not equivalence of every test schedule. No parent drop accepted. event.summary: Fresh output-free rotation fixtures have no setup records pending at adoption
event.detail: Reviewed commit: 1ed482dde220452e424973faf38a5e1318986333. Synthesis revision replaces the earlier inference from no stdout with the complete setup-record check. TLDR: the immediate deterministic rotation samples do not race a protocol/journal setup backlog under their stated fixture premise. ticker.rs:1858-1870 starts fresh sh -c sleep 300 hosts with initial_snapshot None and an explicit 80x24 initial size; :4692-4694, :4768 and :4798-4800 issue no input/resize before sampling. terminal-host/src/journal.rs:137-154 initializes no output, resize, exit or snapshot record, with end=0 and resize_count=0. Its read at Position::default is within that empty retained tail (:344-355), and next_in_tail returns None rather than a setup record when the offset is at end (:406-445). Host::new only constructs that journal (host.rs:225-244); resize records are appended only on an actual ClientMessage::Resize (:805-820). Connection setup queues Welcome only (:961-977); Info queues an InfoReply and Read only creates the cursor (:757-785), neither changing the journal. Input acknowledgements are queued only for resolved/discarded input (:557-567, :585-625); adoption sends none. hosts/client.rs:1103-1140 routes InfoReply to its request cell rather than the event queue; the event queue contains journal records or input acknowledgements. Thus the empty journal has no queued setup event: hosts/terminal.rs:1821-1826 sees fence=0 and adopted_end=(0,0), and :1858 initializes caught_up=true before the runtime is spawned. The first-record guarantee is not needed for this empty-stream case: terminal-host/SPEC.md:237-242 explicitly conditions it on an existing record; Terms:33-34 states "The size given at spawn is not a resize." For a nonempty stream, adopt processes only one queued event (:1916-1925); on_event decrements the fence (:3343-3344), and record publication sets caught_up only after fence=0 and the adopted position is reached (:4010-4019). Suggested bucket: other (test readiness concern). Confidence: confirmed by source and contract, no execution. proposed_drop: no pending setup record exists in the specific fresh output-free fixtures, so the claimed deterministic-sample race is not established; no parent drop accepted. Could-be-highest: no established security or loss-of-work route. possible_cover: none searched. Caveats preserved: this does not turn Fresh adoption into a general full-journal readiness guarantee; output-producing/recovered fixtures still require their own processed-state oracle, and unexpected child output or an early child exit violates the quiet live fixture premise. No unresolved source premise remains for the setup-record concern.
